description: Angular component for a keyboard shortcuts cheat sheet, including styling, template, and logic for toggling visibility and handling hotkeys.

classes.name: TbCheatSheetComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing a visual cheat sheet for keyboard shortcuts, with toggle functionality and hotkey bindings.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, filtering hotkeys with descriptions.

methods.name: setHotKeys
methods.description: Updates the list of hotkeys displayed in the cheat sheet.

methods.name: toggleCheatSheet
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the cheat sheet.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unbinds the '?' hotkey when the component is destroyed.
